title: Detroit After Dark Private Evening City Lights Tour
includes: Complimentary pickup from Downtown Detroit hotels (advance request required)
Scenic Detroit skyline and waterfront photo stops
Live guided narration and local storytelling
Executive climate-controlled Ford Transit Shuttle transportation
Private Detroit After Dark tour for up to 14 guests
Alcohol not included. BYOB permitted in accordance with Michigan Shuttle policies.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Vehicle has step entry; guests should be able to board with minimal assistance. Please request child safety seats at the time of booking.
This tour includes brief periods of walking and standing at scenic viewpoints. Guests should be comfortable entering and exiting the vehicle several times during the experience.
policies: This private tour operates rain or shine. Please dress appropriately for the weather, as several scenic stops include short outdoor walks for sightseeing and photography. Comfortable walking shoes are recommended.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience Detroit after dark on a private, fully guided evening tour showcasing the city's illuminated skyline, iconic landmarks, waterfront, and vibrant downtown. 

Travel in comfort aboard an Executive Ford Transit Shuttle with your own Local Detroit Guide, enjoying scenic photo stops, fascinating storytelling, and a personalized itinerary designed exclusively for your group of up to 14 guests. 

Complimentary Downtown Detroit hotel pickup is included with advance request, making this a seamless and unforgettable way to experience the Motor City at night.
